value.title: 133 — rs pane observer supersedes legacy taps; deferred pane delivery names its reason and retries
value.summary: pij-rs spawn distinguishes dispatched from bound and surfaces a named failure with the child's last log lines when the pane dies before the seat binds.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Witness 2026-09-02 (weasel): a hand-started Copilot CLI in tmux, adopted into pij-rs (pij-accused-keech, %3136), received NOTHING from `pij-rs send` — receipt said `queued`, no pointer, no body, no daemon log line for the pane. Cause: the HELD legacy TS daemon pipe-panes every pane on the machine into ~/.pij/pane-signals/_N.raw and sets no @pij-tap-sink marker; crates/tmux/src/lib.rs ~L868 sees pane_pipe=1 with no matching marker and refuses (`already has an output pipe not owned by this sink`), so InteractionGate::refresh_live_tap returns false, fresh_injection_verdict returns permitted=false/composer_idle=false, submit_with_owned_input returns Deferred, and the row sits queued forever with no reason. Proof: `tmux pipe-pane -t %3136` (close legacy pipe) → rs observer claimed the tap within 20s → second send returned delivered/typed-to-pane and Copilot answered `seen`. Same refusal is spamming ~25k daemon.log lines for %3112 (CPU + disk). The legacy daemon stays running until seat migration (req-0039) lands, so rs must coexist: supersede legacy-generation taps, still refuse genuinely foreign pipes, log once per pane, and make the queued receipt say WHY and retry once the tap is owned. This is the s122 full-body delivery (PR #355, merged dd450381) being blocked at the tap, not at the typing.

value.text: Hand-started Copilot/Codex panes get full-body typed delivery even when the legacy daemon tapped the pane first.
rs pane observer adopts a legacy-generation tap (pane_pipe=1, no @pij-tap-sink marker, legacy sink ~/.pij/pane-signals/_N.raw present) instead of refusing; genuinely unknown pipes are still refused.

A pane delivery deferred for want of a tap sink returns `queued` WITH a reason (`tap-unowned`), is logged once per pane not per tick, and the drain retries it after the tap is claimed (req-0042 partial).
Adopt/register records the harness process, not the pane shell, when a harness was started from an interactive shell; UDS discovery falls back to the session record pane match.
Killing or modifying the legacy TS daemon (held by ruling 2026-09-02-legacy-shutdown-held-for-129.md).
Composer-busy / human-typing deferral policy (req-0042 remainder) beyond naming the reason.
Any write to the operator homes (~/.claude, ~/.claude-alt, ~/.pij, ~/.pij-rs) before merge; live proof runs a dev daemon on its own state dir/port with the production legacy daemon left RUNNING.

LIVE: hand-start `copilot --yolo` in a new tmux window; confirm the legacy tap is present (`ps` shows `cat >> ~/.pij/pane-signals/_N.raw`, `tmux display -p -t %N #{pane_pipe}` = 1, no @pij-tap-sink marker); adopt into the DEV rs daemon; `pij-rs send` returns delivered/typed-to-pane and the FULL body is visible in the pane with Copilot replying; transcript pasted.
CONTROL on the pre-fix tree (main dd450381): the same gesture returns `queued`, nothing appears in the pane; pasted. Red-first for every new unit test, pre-fix output pasted.
value.claim: the witness was red before the fix

value.text: A pane whose pipe has a FOREIGN non-legacy owner (test: pipe-pane a scratch pane to /tmp/foreign.raw with no marker and no legacy sink file) is still refused, and the refusal is logged ONCE per pane per daemon boot (rate-limited), not every observer tick; unit test + `grep -c` on the dev daemon log pasted.
value.claim: supersede is narrow and refusal stops spamming

value.text: `pij-rs send` to a pane seat with no owned tap returns `{outcome:queued, reason:"tap-unowned"}` (additive field, wire stays v2), and once the observer claims the tap the drain delivers the queued row without a second send; integration test + live transcript pasted.
value.claim: queued names its reason and retries

value.text: `just checks` green on the rebased tree (req-0044 baseline reds excluded by name only); no changes under .pi/extensions (legacy) and no operator-home writes (`git diff --stat` + `ls -la ~/.pij ~/.pij-rs` mtimes pasted).

LIVE: a Claude Code hand-started INSIDE an existing zsh pane (pane_pid = the shell, claude is its child; witness: pij-still-weasel %2081, row proc.pid=6624 shell while /tmp/cc-socks/82124.sock + ~/.claude/sessions/82124.json belong to the live claude) is reachable by socket: after adopt/auto-adopt the row proc names the HARNESS process (or UDS discovery matches the pane via the session record `tmux` field), `pij-rs send` returns delivered/injected-to-transport and the turn arrives in Claude; before the fix the same send returns queued with nothing shown (control pasted).
